title: Jesus on Impurity and the Condition of the Heart
description: Pharisees and scribes from Jerusalem confront Jesus, saying that his disciples do not wash their hands before eating. Jesus replies that they themselves nullify God's command for the sake of their own traditions, and calls them hypocrites, quoting Isaiah. He explains to the crowd and the disciples that it is not what enters the mouth that makes a person unclean, but what comes out of the mouth and originates from the heart—evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and blasphemy.
